title: Align the dashboard readiness test double with the rooted worker-status API

source.failure: test_dashboard_core_readiness_focuses_on_product_loop raises TypeError because its worker_status test double accepts zero arguments while production passes the workspace root

objective: Fix the stale dashboard readiness test seam so the focused core-readiness test passes with the current rooted worker-status API. Do not weaken or delete the product-loop assertions, and do not change the production worker-status contract merely to accommodate the test double.
acceptance_criteria: The test still asserts successful agents, intake, and worker checks.
Commercial auth and billing checks remain excluded from core readiness.
The change is limited to one test file unless the current frozen baseline proves the production contract itself is wrong.
